Discharge Summary – Ashfield Private Hospital

Status: Final

Type: Discharge summary

Encounter: Peri-operative encounter (day surgery admission - cone biopsy of cervix), Ashfield Private Hospital, 2025-11-01 08:00–16:00

Date: 2025-11-01

Author: Dr Mark Wilson, Surgeon, Ashfield Private Hospital

Custodian: Ashfield Private Hospital

Admitted for day surgery, 2025-11-01. Cone biopsy of cervix performed 09:00–10:30 under general anaesthesia; blood loss 100 mL; no complications. Discharged home the same day at 16:00 (disposition: Other/Home).
01/11/2025 Cone biopsy of cervix (day surgery), performed by Dr Mark Wilson. Procedure successful under general anaesthesia; blood loss 100 mL; no complications.
01/11/2025 Ibuprofen 400 mg every 6–8 hours as needed for pain (max 2.4 g/day), 5 days; Paracetamol 500 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain (max 4 g/day), 5 days

Non-pharmacologic measures: heating pad, deep breathing, hydration. Activity restrictions: no lifting >5 kg. Follow-up appointments arranged: GP review (Dr Chris Lee, Bathurst Medical Centre), 2025-11-08 (7 days post-op); Pelvic-health physiotherapy (Sarah Evans, Bathurst Physio Centre), 2025-11-10; Psycho-oncology counselling (Dr Rachel Patel, Telehealth), 2025-11-15.
